Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 6 of 6; child 12 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Add an optional JavaFX host adapter for the supported hover/focus/selection/navigation/linked-state behaviors, using the portable interaction plan and controller semantics. Keep toolkit dependencies out of core and shared interaction code.

Acceptance criteria
1. Shared traces yield equivalent logical events and selected keys in JavaFX and browser backends for declared supported capabilities.
2. Actual JavaFX input, application-thread ownership, keyboard focus, navigation, tooltip/inspector access, and disposal are verified on the supported runtime.
3. Renderer and host capability differences are explicit and actionable rather than silent no-ops.
4. Publish a runnable desktop example and host capability matrix; static JavaFX rendering remains independently usable.
5. Desktop evidence identifies OS/JDK/OpenJFX/source versions; headless recording tests are not reported as native UI proof.

Exclusions
Claiming all-host parity from browser or headless tests; mandatory Laminar/notebook/Shiny dependencies.

Required evidence
Native JavaFX input/lifecycle checks, shared trace comparisons, desktop screenshots, tested-runtime records, and external-host example.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B4A5WWQVG4SYJX7MMD3B

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 12] Implement JavaFX interaction through the shared state and picking contracts
